verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs claim in-product AI capabilities over the user's data. These include natural-language interaction with telemetry, an AI SRE (nightshift) that investigates incidents and delivers evidence-backed root cause, and AI-driven log parsing and analysis in Streams. That covers the 'insights' half of the story. The 'suggestions' half (recommended remediations or next steps) is not explicitly documented, and all support comes from marketing-level claims without depth or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit AI-generated suggestions or recommended actions, in-depth docs on the AI assistant/AI SRE workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
Streams leverages AI to automatically parse, structure, and analyze log data on the fly.
This includes zero-config anomaly detection, pattern analysis, and the ability to surface correlations and root causes.
